build_Select_module: build a Select module to apply a neural network module on a subset of input channels
build_Select_drop_other: build a Select module with drop_other=True to discard non-selected channels and return only the transformed subset
build_Layer_wrapper: build a Layer wrapper to invoke a functional layer by name with keyword arguments
build_Layer_with_parameters: build a Layer wrapper that auto-registers tensor kwargs as trainable Parameters or buffers
review_Layer_repr: review the Layer class __repr__ method to understand how it formats kwargs and buffer values
